final: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(b.spent / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id COLLATE BINARY = b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY e.type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM type_averages) SELECT t.event_type, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg FROM type_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
